summary: Lists the 22-level variable precedence order from command-line values and role defaults (lowest) through inventory, facts, play vars, role vars, block/task vars, include_vars, registered vars/set_facts, role and include params, to extra vars (highest).
questions: What is Ansible's variable precedence order?
Do role defaults override inventory variables?
Which wins, include_vars or inventory host_vars?

answer_card.title: Variable precedence order
answer_card.answer_md:
Lowest to highest:

1. Command-line values (e.g. `-u`, not variables)
2. Role defaults
3. Inventory file/script group vars
4. Inventory `group_vars/all`
5. Playbook `group_vars/all`
6. Inventory `group_vars/*`
7. Playbook `group_vars/*`
8. Inventory file/script host vars
9. Inventory `host_vars/*`
10. Playbook `host_vars/*`
11. Host facts / cached set_facts
12. Play vars
13. Play vars_prompt
14. Play vars_files
15. Role vars
16. Block vars
17. Task vars
18. include_vars
19. Registered vars and set_facts
20. Role (and include_role) params
21. include params
22. **Extra vars** (`-e`, always win)
